page.overview:
Who is Baelor?

Baelor was a male Rodian shopkeeper who operated the Baelor's Baubles and Bibelots shop in Spindlehub Square in the underworld of the planet Coruscant during the New Republic Era. He was known for his wide selection of holobooks and data-tapes, which he sold alongside numerous antiques. Although he presented himself as gruff, he softened when discussing the serial Under the Tan-Tan Sun with the human Ardent Quay, who visited his shop around 33 ABY.

Baelor sold Quay a rare holobook of the serial's last installment and secretly gave her a celestialabe with her purchase. Quay soon noticed the additional item, and upon returning to the shop, found Baelor collapsed from a blaster wound. The Rodian was shot by First Order agents in pursuit of Luke Skywalker's yellow lightsaber, which another patron, Sian Alakor, had brought to the shop. Clinging to life, Baelor pulled a hidden blaster pistol from his clothing, eliminating two of the four First Order attackers before being fatally wounded by a second blaster bolt.
